title: Polar grid: annulus between two held arcs (log profile, analytic)
description:
Steady conduction in a quarter annulus a < r < b on a polar (r, phi) domain (coordinates 'polar', radius_min = a, angle span pi/2): the inner arc x_lo is held at T_i, the outer arc x_hi at T_o, the rays y_lo / y_hi are insulated, so the problem is radial. The conductor is a circle about the origin (radius b + 1 mm), painted at the mapped cell centres; the arcs are coordinate lines, so nothing staircases.
Analytic: T(r) = T_i + (T_o - T_i) ln(r / a) / ln(b / a); heat flow through the quarter q' / 4 = (pi / 2) k (T_i - T_o) / ln(b / a).
Derived values tab: theta_probe (probe at a cell-centre radius on the diagonal: the point mapping), T_mean (area mean over the sector cells: the exact sector areas), q_quarter (integral of the heat_flux_abs magnitude over the sector / (b - a) = q' / 4). Expect < 1e-3 (second order: the arithmetic r_f / dr faces, cell-centre fluxes).
Line profile tab: T_diagonal (log profile along phi = pi/4; the field is a containing-cell image of the polar cells, so expect ~1 % of the rise).

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: radial cell size (also the cell length along the outer arc)

parameters.name: q_quarter_ref
parameters.description: analytic heat flow through the quarter annulus in W/m

parameters.name: T_mean_ref
parameters.description: analytic area mean of T over the annulus in K
